sources.snippet: Segments Toxoplasma gondii parasitophorous vacuoles from a parasite stain (anti-Toxoplasma-biotin, or DsRed in the PV lumen). Round 5 — the current promoted PV model, superseding round 2 (Toxoplasma PV v1).

sources.title: toxoplasma-pv-segmentation-cpsam by Einar Olafsson
sources.snippet: Toxoplasma PV v1 Segments Toxoplasma gondii parasitophorous vacuoles from a parasite stain (anti-Toxoplasma-biotin, or DsRed in the PV lumen). Round 2. Superseded. Toxoplasma PV v2 (round 5) is trained on 556 images against this model's 229 and is 5-fold cross-validated. Prefer v2 for new work; v1 remains here for reproducibility.

sources.title: toxoplasma-pv-segmentation-cpsam-r5 by Einar Olafsson
sources.snippet: Training data 556 curated training images of Toxoplasma tachyzoite parasitophorous vacuoles, stained with goat anti-Toxoplasma-biotin or expressing DsRed in the PV lumen (RH and ME49), accumulated over five rounds of curation. 100 epochs from stock cpsam_v2, AdamW, lr 1e-5, weight decay 0.1. Cross-validation folds are in training/folds.csv.

sources.title: GitHub - EinarOlafsson/EinarOlafsson: Biologist and Python developer at ...
sources.snippet: What I work on My research focuses on host-parasite interactions, particularly those involving Toxoplasma gondii. I study how this parasite changes the behavior of the cells it infects and interacts with their cellular machinery. My work has ranged from immune-cell signaling and migration to the parasite's use of host proteins and pathways.
